panels.title: Multi-Region Cluster Availability (East US 2 vs West US 3)
East US 2 Primary Cluster - Node Ready Count

azureMonitor.query: KubeNodeInventory | where ClusterName == 'aks-dr-primary-eastus2' and Status == 'Ready' | summarize ReadyNodes=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)

panels.title: West US 3 Secondary Cluster - Node Ready Count (Warm Standby)

azureMonitor.query: KubeNodeInventory | where ClusterName == 'aks-dr-secondary-westus3' and Status == 'Ready' | summarize ReadyNodes=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
KubePodInventory | where Namespace == 'ecommerce' | summarize Restarts=max(PodRestartCount) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
InsightsMetrics | where Namespace == 'container.azm.ms/disk' and Name == 'used_percent' | summarize avg(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

panels.title: Azure Front Door HTTP Ingress Request Count by Origin

azureMonitor.query: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.CDN' and Category == 'FrontDoorAccessLog' | summarize RequestCount=count() by originName_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
